answer_1.quote: In this work, we assess the usefulness of state-of-the-art NMT in professional translation with a strictly controlled cross-language setup.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates translations in six target languages using two NMT systems and professional translators, comparing human translation from scratch and post-editing of machine-translated outputs.

answer_2.quote: we use HuggingFace's Transformers library for all neural models, using the default decoding settings without further fine-tuning. All metrics were computed using the default settings of SacreBLEU and Comet.

answer_4.quote: translators were asked to complete a qualitative assessment regarding their perceptions of MT quality and post-editing effort.
answer_4.guideline: Participants expressed their perception of MT quality and translation speed across HT and PE modalities (HT s , PE s ) using a 1-7 Likert scale (1 slowest, 7 fastest).
